mappingRules: Use explicit authoritative foreign-key association only.
Do not derive calendar years/dates from study_year.
Do not fold global terms 3-10 into TERM_1/TERM_2 using parity without owner-confirmed correspondence.
Do not create periods, guess future dates, or classify Summer.
Existing 10 associations agree with local registry year/term/explicit periodId; no updates needed.
databaseWrites: No mapping/period/curriculum/PDF/billing/access writes. SELECT-only inspection transactions enforced READ ONLY. Browser login used a legitimate existing local test account and can create an ordinary authentication session.

runtime.adminBrowser: NOT VERIFIED: legitimate admin login not available; SELECT/policy/API code inspected only
runtime.requirementVisibilityPreserved: mt-104/en-105 already hidden by unrelated owner-approved requirement visibility; association and policy unchanged

qualityGates.scope: Full gates ran against the working tree including preserved unrelated WIP. No application code modified.

ownerInputRequired: Supply an explicit target academic_period_id for each Study Year 2-5 global term 3-10, including its calendar academic_year.
Clarify whether these years share 2026-2027 TERM_1/TERM_2 or require separate future periods; neither option was inferred.
If targets are absent, provide approved start/end dates in Africa/Cairo and separately authorize creating those periods; current task only allows association updates.
No Summer mappings unless explicitly confirmed in authoritative structured metadata.
safety: No UPDATE, INSERT, DELETE, seeds, resets, imports, migrations or visibility rule changes were executed.
